note: Poultry is a concentrate-feed-heavy monogastric system with high reliance on imported protein (soybean meal - Estonia produces 0t soy, PM37 2024). Illustrative bound, not derived from a measured Estonian feed-protein-import share.
Same reasoning as poultry - layer hens are fed a similar concentrate/protein-heavy ration.
Pork is also a concentrate-feed-heavy monogastric system with high imported-protein reliance, same as poultry/eggs.
Cattle (beef) are substantially grass/forage-fed in typical Northern European systems, with proportionally less concentrate/imported-protein feed than pork or poultry - smaller haircut applied.
Sheep/goat are predominantly pasture-grazed - smaller haircut, same reasoning as beef.
Dairy cattle are predominantly grass/silage-fed with grain supplementation (a smaller share of the ration than pork/poultry) - smaller haircut, same reasoning as beef.
